instructions.name: swap
docs: Stable pAMM integration boundary. The pAMM program computes `amount_out`,
transfers input into the input custody, then invokes this instruction.

errors.name: UnauthorizedInitializer
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority may initialize the protocol

errors.name: UnsupportedTokenProgram
errors.msg: Only the legacy SPL Token Program is supported

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: AmountTooLarge
errors.msg: Amount is too large for signed inventory accounting

errors.name: PendingRedeemLiquidityReserved
errors.msg: Swap would consume assets reserved for pending redeems

errors.name: PoolNotInitialized
errors.msg: Yield can only be distributed after shares exist

errors.name: InvalidInventoryUpdate
errors.msg: Inventory update must reduce an existing position without flipping its sign

errors.name: EpochUpdateInCooldown
errors.msg: Epoch update is still in cooldown

errors.name: ExchangeRateIncreaseTooMuch
errors.msg: Exchange rate increase is too large

errors.name: OnlyCreditPool
errors.msg: Only whitelisted credit pools may call swap
